title: Variables and expressions: identify terms
metacognition_prompt: Before you start, what single skill is this repair problem checking?

source_reference.notes: Called by Q-012 Q012_WRONG_COEFFICIENTS. Atomicity=alg.variables_expressions; Scenario=Called by Q-012 Q012_WRONG_COEFFICIENTS; Surface variation=yes; No new vocab=yes; Steps=1-2. Edexcel pivot metadata applied.

problem_text: In 4x^2 - 3x + 8, name the coefficient of x.
student_prompt: Answer this short repair question. Keep your working brief.

error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If the answer is 3 instead of -3, the issue is reading a coefficient without its sign. Quadratic formula and standard form work both depend on signed coefficients.

hint_ladder.title: Coefficient meaning
hint_ladder.prompt: The coefficient of x is the number multiplying the x term. Look only at the term with x to the first power.

hint_ladder.title: Separate terms
hint_ladder.prompt: Split the expression into its three terms first. Then choose the signed number attached to the first-power x term.

hint_ladder.title: Keep the sign
hint_ladder.prompt: A common slip is saying 3 and dropping the negative sign. The sign belongs to the coefficient.

hint_ladder.title: Term-reading routine
hint_ladder.prompt: For coefficients, identify the exact term first, then read the signed number attached to it. Use this expression; do not copy.

common_errors: uses the previous larger problem instead of this repair skill
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: This repair focuses on identifying the x term and carrying its negative sign into the coefficient.
